mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over 3 months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth >1.5%) and weak housing starts (HOUST < 1200.0 thousand units) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth >1.5% and HOUST <1200.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior 3 months signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS) signals robust economic activity, compressing risk premiums and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS growth >100k, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, strong retail sales (RSAFS) growth above 0.5% monthly signals sustained consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances during post-recession recoveries when RSAFS growth >0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows <0.03.
